BiblicalUsage: Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite is named among David's mighty men, in the list of those who gather to David at Hebron. He is the same man as Heleb, the name spelled with a different letter.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps the mighty men straight even when the spelling changes. Heled and Heleb are one man, and his place among David's men is sure.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
